declaration: scripts/ict-scan.py V_ICT is the code-side declaration of every value set below; scripts/tests/test_v_items_ict.py asserts the two are equal. The first value of every item is the baseline = v1 behaviour and the key's default.
n_formula: N = 1 baseline + sum over items of (len(values) - 1) + 1 combined = 1 + 27 + 1. Every item is ONE factor: the joint exit factor B-EXIT counts as one item of 12 value sets (11 non-baseline; the 12 `no_floor` sets were removed 2026-09-30), B-LB as one item of 6 value sets (5 non-baseline). B-DISP is sensitivity-only and is not in this file or in N. B4 counts in N although implemented=false.

items.note: entry price on the FVG: iofed = near edge (v1), ce = 0.5 of the gap, fill = far edge

premium/discount range framing: r15 = nearest BSL/SSL pair (v1); r13 = swept extreme to opposing pool (the nearest unswept pool beyond the entry; keeps the r15 edge on that side when there is none). Only the pd_ok range changes: the fallback TARGET edge (used when there is no sigma projection) stays the R15 range.

on = the MOST RECENT completed UTC day's PDH/PDL plus the MOST RECENT completed session (asia, london; sessions.json windows) of each type join the pools -- not every completed day/session in the window. The still-forming day/session and the window-first partial day/session are excluded (point-in-time). The day boundary is UTC 00:00 (pre-registered project choice), which differs from the session registry's New York / London local-clock convention.
stop buffer beyond the swept wick; ATR = simple mean true range over the 14 bars ending at the MSS bar (ATR_PERIOD is project-defined: the plan declares only the multiples)

items.source: models.md §2.1.5; core-b.md §2.12 (target); project (time stop H); models.md §3.1 rule 23 (2R)

components.value_format: <target sigma>|<time stop>|<2R floor token; only `floor` is declared>

items.note: ONE joint key, 3 x 4 x 1 = 12 value sets. H = bt.P[tf]['H'] bars (none = until the end of history); the third token is always `floor`: simulate()'s planned-R:R entry floor (OPTS min_rr, 2.5 net of fee since the owner decision of 2026-09-30) applies to every trade. The engine still understands a `no_floor` token (scripts/ict-scan.py V_ICT, scripts/backtest-methods.py simulate()) but the grid does not declare it: the owner decision 'R:R target when entering a trade must be at least 2.5R' removed it, so min_rr is not a second knob and no grid cell can skip it

<setup lookback>|<K-bar expiry>. 12 is the live default lookback (max(12, recent*6) at recent=2); 8 and 16 scale the live default by 8/12 and 16/12 with int(round()). K = bt.P[tf]['K'] (2K doubles it).

items.source: PROJECT rule (core-b.md §3.1 R3 is the invalidation idea, not an order-cancel rule)
items.note: yes = cancel the pending limit when the target trades before the limit fills: bars mss_i+1 .. fill_bar-1 are checked, the fill bar itself is excluded (a same-bar target/fill is unknowable from OHLC and keeps the v1 fill). Long checks H[j] >= target, short L[j] <= target.

tfa_p5 reads the bias on the paired higher timeframe (1m<-15m, 5m<-1H, 15m<-4H, 1H<-1D) instead of the entry timeframe. Unpaired timeframes (30m, 2H, 4H, 1D) refuse every setup, so the 30m cell yields ZERO trades under tfa_p5: report that as 'no pairing', not as evidence against B3. The gate is keyed on the LTF bar's CLOSE (available_time), never its open.

items.reason: the sources state 'a higher-timeframe level must be engaged before the LTF MSS' but never define what an HTF level is (swing, PDH/PDL, key level) or what 'engaged' means (touched, swept, inside a distance); any operationalisation would invent a rule or a threshold. No key is registered.

items.source: PROJECT session model, docs/architecture/sessions.json (version 2) via scripts/sessions.py -- NOT core-a.md R1's literal 02:00-05:00 EST windows (registry London is 08:00-11:00 Europe/London; the Asia window also counts; ny_am 08:30-11:00 and ny_pm 13:30-16:00 America/New_York; weekends gated). core-a.md R1 / §2.1 only motivates 'killzones exist'.
items.note: killzone = an index (asset_class 'indices') entry must fall inside a session-registry window (DST-aware). The instant tested is the fill bar's OPEN time, a proxy for the fill moment. Metals (XAUUSD) are never restricted.
